target.title: fix: require full frontmatter delimiter lines
target.body:
Closes #101769

AI-assisted with Codex.

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users or plugin authors writing Markdown command, hook, or skill files could have content starting with non-delimiter dash prefixes such as `---not` or `----` interpreted as YAML frontmatter when the file was just ordinary Markdown.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared frontmatter parser now recognizes only full delimiter lines as frontmatter fences, after BOM and line-ending normalization. Claude bundle command prompt stripping now reuses the same markdown-core helper, so metadata parsing and body extraction keep one delimiter contract instead of drifting through a copied prefix check.

## User Impact

Markdown content that starts with dash-prefixed text is preserved as body text unless it starts with a real `---` delimiter line. Valid frontmatter blocks continue to parse, and bundle command prompts no longer lose body content on the `---not` edge case.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/markdown-core/src/frontmatter.test.ts src/plugins/bundle-commands.test.ts src/hooks/frontmatter.test.ts src/skills/loading/frontmatter.test.ts` passed: 2 Vitest shards, 4 test files, 45 tests.
- `./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 packages/markdown-core/src/frontmatter.ts packages/markdown-core/src/frontmatter.test.ts src/plugins/bundle-commands.ts src/plugins/bundle-commands.test.ts src/hooks/frontmatter.test.ts src/skills/loading/frontmatter.test.ts` passed.
- `git diff --check` passed.
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local` passed with no accepted/actionable findings.
- Attempted `pnpm check:changed -- packages/markdown-core/src/frontmatter.ts packages/markdown-core/src/frontmatter.test.ts src/plugins/bundle-commands.ts src/plugins/bundle-commands.test.ts src/hooks/frontmatter.test.ts src/skills/loading/frontmatter.test.ts`; local pnpm deps-status entered `pnpm install` and stalled on optional platform package downloads before checks started, so I interrupted it and left broader check coverage to PR CI.
